releaseNotes.summary: Juno v0.4.0 Beta — Intelligence & Efficiency. Council, /btw, faster everyday replies, a smaller compact installer, and optional browser/Whisper downloads. Unsigned installer; updates are manual.
highlights: Council Mode adds an optional planner and independent reviewer around Bot and Code work. It is off by default.
/btw opens a side conversation with its own task, budget and transcript without disturbing the main task.
Manual model selection is persisted and reported; a stale pin is refused rather than silently replaced.
The compact installer is about 272 MB, down from about 504 MB, and installs about 1.05 GB.
improvements: Reply speed is provider-bound. The earlier CommandCode qualification measured 39–44 ms of Juno dispatch and about 2.4–3.0 seconds end to end; the final packaged Codex smoke measured about 5–7 seconds. These are measurements, not guarantees.
Cold first-turn Juno dispatch improved from 2.699 s to 1.724 s in a matched A/B on the earlier route.
Code Mode keeps its bundled Boreal coordinator, real file edits, permission cards and bounded recovery.
Stale data-directory lease recovery now works on Windows 11 without wmic; a renderer crash reloads once and reattaches.
fixes: Fixed release-stage labels showing an older candidate version instead of 0.4.0.
Fixed the in-app installer verifier rejecting the 0.4.0 stable-version installer and the full variant.
Fixed the in-app verifier treating the approved 1.0.0-rc to 0.4.0 manual migration as an ordinary downgrade.
knownIssues: The Windows installer is unsigned. Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen, and some managed PCs may block it.
Updates are manual. The signed automatic-update bridge from the old 1.0.0-rc line is not qualified.
External providers need your own account, network access, subscription and quota.
The compact build omits the browser engine and Whisper weights; both are optional verified downloads. System.Speech works immediately.
Screen-reader speech-output acceptance is partial; keyboard, focus, contrast, zoom, forced colours and reduced motion were checked.
No enforceable workspace-wide spending hard cap.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows x64. Existing Juno Beta 0.3 profiles upgrade in place with this manual installer; keep the previous installer if you need to roll back.
